driverOnboarding.title: Driver onboarding
driverOnboarding.subtitle: Add your details, licence, and safety acknowledgement to go on trips.
driverOnboarding.noCompanyLinked: No company linked yet — ask your carrier to invite you again.
driverOnboarding.inviteNotAccepted: Invite not accepted yet. Open the invite link from your email, or ask the carrier to resend.
driverOnboarding.activeTitle: Your profile is ready for trips
driverOnboarding.activeBody: When your carrier wins a job, they can assign you. Keep your licence current.
driverOnboarding.suspended: Licence suspended (likely expired). Contact your carrier / Ops.
driverOnboarding.suspendedDesc: Your driver licence has expired and your status is currently suspended from taking trips. Please upload your renewed licence document and update your expiry date below to submit for reactivation.
driverOnboarding.personalHint: Name, mobile, emergency contact, and residential address are required.
driverOnboarding.licenceHint: Enter your licence details, then upload a clear photo or document of your licence.
driverOnboarding.licenceUploadHint: Required — tap to take a photo or choose a document/image of your licence.
driverOnboarding.licenceUploadRequiredNotice: Activation needs your licence file. Number, class, and expiry alone are not enough.
driverOnboarding.confirmHint: Check the summary, acknowledge NHVR, then submit to activate your driver profile.
driverOnboarding.errorLicenceFileRequired: Upload your driver licence document to continue.
driverOnboarding.errorNoCompany: Your driver profile must be linked to a company before uploading.
driverOnboarding.nhvrCheckbox: I acknowledge the heavy vehicle safety and fatigue rules that apply to my trips.

driverInvite.title: Accept your invitation
driverInvite.otpHint: Click Accept invite, then sign in with the one-time code emailed to you.
driverInvite.otpNote: No code on this screen. Accept the invite, then enter the OTP on the login page (email is prefilled).

driverSchedule.title: My Schedule
driverSchedule.subtitle: View your time-off and availability, and request new leave.
driverSchedule.formHint: Your carrier reviews each request before it is confirmed. You will not be matched to new jobs during an approved window.
driverSchedule.requestSuccess: Time-off request submitted. Your carrier will review it shortly.
driverSchedule.datesRequired: Please provide both start and end date/time.
driverSchedule.startBeforeEnd: Start time must be before end time.
driverSchedule.emptyHint: Request time-off above to let your carrier know you are unavailable.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.subtitle: Invite and manage drivers for your transport company.
drivers.pendingReviewHint: After a driver submits licence details, they stay Pending review until Super Admin approves. You can still bid with other Active drivers.
drivers.emptyHint: Invite a driver by email. They complete onboarding via the invite link.
drivers.reliabilityScoreTooltip: Carrier Reliability Score based on on-time delivery and breakdown records
drivers.disableBody: Suspend {{name}} and sign them out. You need at least one other active driver if you are bid-eligible.
drivers.deleteBody: Permanently remove {{name}}? Only allowed if they have never been used on a bid or assignment. Otherwise disable them instead.
drivers.documentsBody: Uploaded documents for {{name}}. Open to view in a new tab.
drivers.toolbarSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or licence…
drivers.emptyFilteredHint: Try clearing the search or filter to see your full driver list.
